stories.name: Chromatic Lantern
stories.title: A lantern of six colours
stories.text: In a pawnshop window, a brass lantern burns with a light that shifts through the colours of mana. The pawnbroker says it was found in an Izzet district, lighting something it should not. An archivist at New Prahv has offered a reward for it.

outcome.text: The pawnbroker wraps the lantern, and its light points toward an Izzet district.

choices.text: Ask to hold it a moment

outcome.text: You lift the lantern, and its light flares in your hands.

huge_success.text: The light settles into a steady beam, and the pawnbroker, unnerved, gives it to you for free.

success.text: The lantern chooses you, and the pawnbroker lets you go with it.

failure.text: The light burns your fingers, and the pawnbroker locks it away.

huge_failure.text: The flare blinds you, and you knock over a shelf you must pay for.

outcome.text: The lantern flickers as you walk away.

stories.name: Civic Saber
stories.title: A blade that answers to the guilds
stories.text: A guildless smith is selling a saber with a hilt of many-coloured enamel. It is sharper, she says, in the hands of someone who stands with the guilds. Those without a signet carry it instead.

outcome.text: The enamel glows at your touch, and she sells it to you at a guild price.
She buckles the saber to your belt.
She sighs and lets you try your luck at the price.

success.text: She throws up her hands and sells it for a song.

failure.text: She tires of you and sells the saber to someone else.

stories.name: Street Sweeper
stories.intro: A brass street sweeper rolls down the lane, scrubbing away refuse with spinning brushes. It does not slow for anything too clumsy to move. Its brushes turn toward you.
stories.win: The sweeper's gears click into a new pattern, and it trundles after you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: The brushes scrub you into the gutter with the rest of the refuse.
stories.flee: You leap clear, and it sweeps on down the lane.
